products.title: Aloe Vera
products.description: Known for its medicinal properties, its thick, fleshy leaves contain a soothing gel. Ideal for indoor and outdoor settings.

symbolism.origin: Known as the 'Plant of Immortality' in ancient Egyptian papyri; presented across Mediterranean and Asian cultures as a living talisman of healing, protection, and endurance.

growing_instructions: Pot in gritty cactus mix containing perlite and coarse sand in April or May.
Active succulent leaf growth and pup production occur from June through August.
Extremely frost-tender; cannot tolerate freezing temperatures and must stay indoors from November to March.
Dormant in cold weather from December to February; water only once a month.
care_instructions: Water deeply, then allow soil to dry completely before next irrigation.
Keep indoors near bright window during cold winter months (above 10°C).
Never leave root ball sitting in pooled drainage water.
Harvest lowest outer fleshy leaves cleanly from base as needed for skin soothing.

products.title: Black Rose Succulent
products.description: Stunning dark-leaved succulent forming rose-like clusters. Deep burgundy to black coloring creates dramatic contrast. Collector's favorite.

symbolism.origin: Aeonium arboreum 'Zwartkop' produces dramatic dark burgundy-black rosettes; in botanical symbolism, it signifies elegance, transformative mystery, and quiet individuality.

growing_instructions: Repot in gritty porous compost in spring during April or autumn in September.
Grows actively in cool spring and autumn; slows down during peak summer heat in July.
Frost will turn fleshy leaves to mush; bring indoors to a bright windowsill from November through March.
Keep nearly dry during cold winter dormancy from December to February.
care_instructions: Water moderately in spring and autumn; reduce watering significantly in hot summer dormancy.
Protect from severe winter frost below 0°C by keeping indoors near south window.
Dust rosettes with soft dry brush to maintain velvety sheen.

products.title: Desert Cactus
products.description: Low-maintenance desert cactus variety. Ideal for indoor decor and xeriscaping. Requires minimal watering.

symbolism.origin: In Native American and Southwestern lore, cacti symbolize maternal warmth, unyielding endurance, and protective love because they survive and thrive in the harshest conditions.

growing_instructions: Plant in mineral pumice and sand cactus mix in late spring from May to June.
Active growth and occasional flowers occur from June through August in full sun.
Must stay strictly indoors in warm, dry rooms away from snow and freezing cold from November to March.
Withhold watering completely during cold winter months from December to February.
care_instructions: Water thoroughly every 2-3 weeks during summer; let soil become bone dry.
Suspend watering almost entirely from November through February during cold winter rest.
Keep in well-ventilated dry room away from high humidity.

products.title: Echeveria Succulent
products.description: Beautiful rosette-forming succulent with thick, fleshy leaves. Pink, blue, or purple tinges depending on variety. Ideal container plant.

symbolism.origin: Named after Mexican botanical artist Atanasio Echeverría; its compact water-storing geometric petals symbolize enduring affection, balanced beauty, and persistence.

growing_instructions: Repot rosettes into free-draining succulent soil in April or May.
Forms compact, colorful leaf rosettes from May to September in bright sunshine.
Freezing temperatures destroy succulent foliage; overwinter indoors on a sunny sill from November through March.
Water only once every 3-4 weeks from December to February.
care_instructions: Water directly onto soil around base using soak-and-dry method.
Never allow water drops to sit inside the central rosette crown to prevent fungal rot.
Remove withered dried lower leaves promptly to prevent pest harboring.

products.title: Green Pinwheel Succulent
products.description: Charming rosette succulent with lime-green leaves forming pinwheel pattern. Compact and perfect for small spaces and collections.

symbolism.origin: The circular pinwheel geometry of Aeonium rosettes has long symbolized good fortune, refreshing vitality, and continuous renewal in domestic spaces.

growing_instructions: Root branch cuttings in sandy cactus compost in April or September.
Active growth runs through mild spring (April-May) and autumn (September-October).
Not frost hardy in Kashmir; protect indoors in well-lit rooms from November through March.
Reduce water to once monthly during cold winter months from December to February.
care_instructions: Water when top half of container mix dries out during active autumn-spring growth.
Keep in frost-free room during freezing Kashmir winter.
Rotate pot weekly so rosette grows evenly symmetrical toward light.

products.title: Kalanchoe
products.description: Succulent kalanchoe with fleshy leaves and bright cluster flowers. Very low maintenance, thrives in dry conditions. Perfect for beginners.

symbolism.origin: Celebrated in Asian botanical traditions and European floristry as a plant of endurance, prosperity, and continuous affection due to its enduring blooms.

growing_instructions: Repot after winter bloom fades in April or May in well-drained compost.
Builds foliage through summer (June-August); short autumn days in October initiate flower buds.
Must be kept indoors at 15-20°C from November through March for vibrant winter blooming.
Water moderately while in bloom; let topsoil dry out between waterings.
care_instructions: Water thoroughly only when potting mix is completely dry; avoid standing water in saucers.
Feed with diluted low-nitrogen succulent fertilizer once a month in summer.
Trim spent flower stalks at base when blooming cycle finishes to encourage lush foliage.
Provide 14 hours of daily darkness for 6 weeks in autumn to re-induce flower bud formation.

products.title: Peanut Cactus
products.description: Unique cactus with segmented stems resembling peanuts. Orange-red flowers bloom in spring. Great for containers and collectors.

symbolism.origin: Echinopsis chamaecereus produces playful clumping peanut-like finger stems that bloom in fiery orange; it symbolizes tenacious resilience and finding joy in rugged terrain.

growing_instructions: Plant clustering finger stems in gritty cactus compost in April or May.
Produces striking bright scarlet-orange flowers in late spring from May to June.
Requires cool but frost-free winter rest (5-10°C) indoors from November to March to set flower buds.
Keep soil completely dry from December to February.
care_instructions: Water every 10-14 days in summer; keep completely dry in winter.
A cool winter rest (5-10°C) is required to trigger sensational spring flowering.
Handle finger offsets gently when repotting.
